parameters.name: narrativeSections
parameters.label: Narrative sections
parameters.description: Caller-resolved [{label, content}] -- only sections with a saved jfb_weekly_summaries entry for this week (mirrors the vanilla app's PDF: prints the PM's saved rollup, never the daily reference entries). Built by buildNarrativeSectionsParam() in weeklySummary.js.

parameters.name: weeklyProduction
parameters.label: Weekly production
parameters.description: Caller-computed {weekCy, weekSf, toDateCy, toDateSf, goal}, pre-formatted strings, from the same dvw-jfb-metric-cy/sf data views the on-screen page calls.

parameters.name: weeklyDelays
parameters.label: Weekly delay breakdown
parameters.description: Caller-computed [{description, hours}] from buildWeeklyReport()'s hours.byDelayLabel -- approximate, jfb_daily_activities has no category column (see METRICS_MIGRATION_PLAN.md).

parameters.name: weeklyPhotoAssets
parameters.label: Weekly photo assets
parameters.description: Caller-resolved {"1": {label, dataUri}|null, "2": {...}|null}, one per uploaded jfb_weekly_summary_photos slot for this project+week. Resolved client-side via downloadAttachment() + base64 data-URI conversion, because the render engine cannot fetch a Pivotly file's bytes by id from inside a domain-query source, and the Asset Manifest only supports a fixed fileId set at publish time, not one that changes per week.
